title: Skuul: Open-Source School Management Built on Laravel
content:
Skuul 3.0 is an open-source school management app on Laravel 13 and Livewire 4, with per-campus roles, gradebooks, a family portal, and fee tracking.

The post Skuul: Open-Source School Management Built on Laravel appeared first on Laravel News.
